[II] BSP RESERVES THE RIGHT TO REJECT THE OFFERS BASED ON DOCUMENTS SUBMITTED BY THE BIDDER S WITH OR WITHOUT SEEKING ADDITIONAL CLARIFICATIONS. HENCE, BIDDERS ARE REQUESTED TO SUBMI T THE DOCUMENTS ALONG WITH THE OFFERS IN TOTALITY. [III] MAY KINDLY NOTE THAT GEM PO SHALL BE REGULARIZED THROUGH SAP ORDER. ALL POST GEM ORDE R ACTIVITIES I.E. MATERIAL RECEIPTS & GRN, BILL PROCESSING AND ANY OTHER POST ORDER ACTIVITY SHALL BE DON E OVER SAIL BSP’S SAP. SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS: 1) BIDS ARE INVITED FROM FOLLOWING BSP (BHILAI STEEL PLANT) PREFERRED MAKE MANUFACTURERS: 1. M/S MSA (INDIA) LTD 2. M/S DRAGER SAFETY INDIA PVT LTD 3. M/s HONEYWELL INTERNATIONAL INDIA PVT.LTD 4. M/s UNIPHOS ENVIROTRONIC PVT LTD THE BIDS SUBMITTED BY THE SELLERS TO WHOM LTE HAS BEEN ISSUED, SHALL ONLY BE CONSIDERED FO R EVALUATION; BIDS FROM ANY OTHER SELLER SHALL BE TREATED AS UNSOLICITED IN THE INSTANT PRO

CUREMENT CASE. HOWEVER, THE FIRM(S) INTERESTED TO BE REGISTERED AS A SELLER TO SAIL, SHOULD FILL UP THE VENDOR REGISTRATION FORM, HOSTED ON THE SAIL TENDER WEBSITE AND COMPLETE THE DUE PROCESS OF REGISTRATION WITH SAIL PLANTS/ UNITS. IN CASE OF SUBMISSION OF OFFER BY BIDDERS HAVING AUTHORIZATION FROM THE MANUFACTURERS (A S MENTIONED ABOVE), FOLLOWING MAY BE NOTED: (A) OFFER SHALL BE SUBMITTED WITH TENDER SPECIFIC (DULY MENTIONING THE GEM BID NUMBER) VALI D AUTHORIZATION OF MANUFACTURER (B) BACK-UP GUARANTEE, FROM THE MANUFACTURER, FOR QUALITY & WORKMANSHIP OF MATERIAL SHAL L BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH SUPPLIES. [NOTE: SUBMISSION OF OFFER BY THE VENDOR SHALL CONSTRU E THAT THEY HAVE ACCEPTED THE CONDITION STATED ABOVE. NOTE: 1. ORDER SHALL BE PLACED ON A SINGLE PARTY ON OVERALL L1 BASIS AS ALL LINE ITEMS ARE MATCHING PARTS. 2. ACCEPTED MAKE OF DETECTORS ARE: DRAGER,HONEYWELL,UNIPHOS,MSA 3. HIGHER CO DETECTION RANGE I.E MORE THAN 1500PPM GAS DETECTORS FOR CO DETECTION WILL AL SO BE ACCEPTABLE. 4. THE POWER SUPPLY TO THE DETECTORS SHOULD BE FROM INBUILT REPLACEABLE NON RECHARGEABL E BATTERIES. 5. 1027 NOS. OF EXTRA BATTERIES/BATTERY SET OF SAME MAKE AND MODEL WHICH IS USED IN THE SUP PLIED GAS DETECTORS TO BE SUPPLIED FREE OF COST ALONG WITH THE GAS DETECTORS. THE BATTERIE S MUST HAVE A MINIMUM SHELF LIFE OF ONE YEAR FROM THE DATE OF SUPPLY OF THESE FREE BATTERIE S TO BSP. 6. 10 NOS. OF CALIBRATION ADAPTORS TO BE SUPPLIED FREE OF COST ALONG WITH THE DETECTORS. IF THE CALIBRATION ADAPTORS ARE INBUILT ALONG WITH EACH DETECTOR, SAME TO BE DECLARED THROU GH A LETTER AND IN SUCH CASE FREE SUPPLY OF CALIBRATION ADAPTORS WILL NOT BE NEEDED. 7. ALL THE PASSWORDS REQUIRED FOR OPERATION/CALIBRATION OF DETECTORS TO BE MADE AVAILABLE TO EMD, BSP. ALSO, ANY SOFTWARE/CABLE REQUIRED FOR CONNECTING THE DETECTORS WITH PC FOR MONITORING/CHANGING SETTINGS/CALIBRATION TO BE MADE AVAILABLE FREE OF COST. 8. THE WARRANTY/GUARANTEE PERIOD OF DETECTORS WILL BE FOR 2 YEARS FROM THE DATE OF SUPPLY TO BSP. 9. DETECTORS SHOULD BE APPROVED BY : PESO (NAGPUR) OR ATEX/ IECEX/, UL/C-UL/CE . SELF ATTESTED PHOTOCOPY/SCANNED COPY OF THE APPROVALS TO BE SUBMITTED BY THE VENDOR DURING ENQUIRY SU BMISSION AND ALSO ALONG WITH THE SUPPLY. 10. OPERATING MANUAL/INSTRUCTION MANUAL/CDS TO BE SUPPLIED WITH THE DETECTORS. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR SUPPLY AND CALIBRATION OF PORTABLE CO GAS DETECTORS. (A) Delivery Date and Calibration Schedule 1. Tentative delivery date of 01.04.2027 for the gas detectors. The calibration schedule stated is based on this tentative date. 2. The actual delivery date will be known before issue of the Purchase Order (PO). Upon receipt of the conf irmed delivery date from the Purchase Officer, the revised calibration schedule shall be communicated by the indenting/user department and incorporated in the PO for compliance by the L1 vendor. 3. If the detectors are supplied and accepted by BSP before or after the delivery date stated in the PO, the dates of free and paid calibration shall be suitably adjusted in line with the actual date of supply and accep tance. (B)Scope and Quantity of Calibration 4. ITEM SCHEDULE. NO. 1 (51010301000029): 1,027 EA portable CO gas detectors are to be supplied. The quantity and delivery date shall be as specified in the PO.

5. Initial free calibration of all supplied detectors shall be carried out by the vendor's service engineer at th e Energy Management Department (EMD), BSP site, within seven days of intimation by EMD after receipt a nd inspection clearance of the detectors at BSP Stores. 6. After the initial free calibration, paid calibration shall be carried out once every six months for two years at EMD, BSP site. 7. For FY 2027-28 (ITEM SCHEDULE. NO. 2- 510103010000066), paid calibration shall be carried out in Sep tember 2027 and March 2028, covering 1,027 detectors per cycle, subject to availability. The scheduled n umber of calibration activities is therefore 1,027 × 2 = 2,054 detector-calibrations. 8. For FY 2028-29 (ITEM SCHEDULE. NO. 2- 510103010000066), paid calibration shall be carried out in Sep tember 2028 and March 2029, covering 1,027 detectors per cycle, subject to availability. The scheduled n umber of calibration activities is therefore 1,027 × 2 = 2,054 detector-calibrations. (C)Calibration Location, Equipment and Vendor's Arrangements 9. All calibration activities shall be carried out at the EMD work site inside Bhilai Steel Plant (BSP) by the ve ndor's service engineer. 10. The vendor shall provide and arrange all equipment and consumables required for calibration, includin g its own calibration/docking station, NIST-approved calibration gas cylinders, flow regulators, tools and ot her necessary accessories. 11. The service engineer shall bring sufficient calibration gas cylinders to complete the scheduled work. Calibration shall not be interrupted due to shortage or exhaustion of calibration gas cylinders. 12. Accommodation, lodging, boarding, food, transportation/conveyance, stay in Bhilai and all other expen ses associated with deployment of the service engineer shall be in the vendor's scope. 13. The vendor shall plan deployment of its service engineer sufficiently in advance to complete the calibr ation within the scheduled period. (D)Calibration Schedule and Working Hours 14. BSP shall intimate the calibration schedule to the vendor through mobile phone, email, WhatsApp or te xt message. The vendor shall strictly adhere to the communicated schedule. 15. A minimum visit duration of 10 working days shall be provided/required for each calibration cycle, as a pplicable to the quantity made available for calibration. 16. Calibration work at BSP shall normally be carried out from 10:00 AM to 4:30 PM, excluding Sundays an d closed holidays. 17. BSP shall make all reasonable efforts to collect and make available the distributed gas detectors from different departments for calibration. However, the quantity available on the scheduled dates may be less than the total quantity supplied. 18. No claim shall be entertained for detectors that could not be calibrated because they were not made a vailable by BSP. 19. If the complete quantity of detectors cannot be calibrated during a scheduled visit due to insufficient a vailability at BSP, the calibration visit may, depending on the prevailing situation and by mutual agreemen t between BSP and the vendor, be extended or rescheduled. (E)Calibration Records, Certificates and Identification 20. After each calibration cycle/visit, the vendor shall provide calibration certificates for the calibrated dete ctors, duly signed by the vendor's authorized representative. 21. The vendor shall provide a consolidated certificate/list of calibrated detectors within one week from co mpletion of the calibration activity, on the company's letterhead. 22. A sticker shall be affixed to the back of each calibrated detector indicating the next due date of calibra tion. 23. The calibration certificate issued by the vendor and the calibration conduction/completion certificate is sued by EMD shall form the basis for payment for calibration activities.

(F)Payment Terms 24. Supply of detectors – Line Item 10: 90% payment shall be made upon supply of the detectors and com pletion of inspection/clearance at BSP Stores. The remaining 10% shall be released after successful compl etion of the scheduled calibration activities, as certified by EMD, at the end of the two-year calibration peri od, for the detectors made available for calibration. 25. Calibration – Line Items 20 and 30: Payment shall be made at 100% of the actual number of detectors calibrated. The payable quantity shall be established from the vendor's calibration certificates and the corr esponding EMD’s calibration conduction/completion certificate. 26. Where the service engineer is not deployed by the vendor on the date requested by BSP for reasons at tributable to the vendor, a deduction of Rs. 500 per delayed day shall be made from the vendor's calibrati on bill or, where applicable, from the final 10% payment. 27. If calibration work is stopped because the vendor's calibration gas cylinders are exhausted or otherwis e become insufficient during a visit or for any reason attributable to the vendor, a deduction of Rs. 500 per day shall be made for each day of stoppage until calibration recommences. (G) Summary of Calibration Schedule:- (A) Initial Free Calibration:- - Within 7 days of EMD’s intimation after supply & inspection clearance; tentatively April 2027. - Quantity Per Cycle:- 1027 - Total Scheduled Detector-Calibrations:- 1027 (B) Paid calibration – FY 2027-28:- - In September 2027 & March 2028. - Quantity Per Cycle:- 1027 - Total Scheduled Detector-Calibrations:- 2054 (C) Paid calibration – FY 2028-29 - In September 2028 & March 2029. - Quantity Per Cycle:- 1027 - Total Scheduled Detector-Calibrations:- 2054 (H) General Conditions 28. The calibration schedule is tentative and shall be adjusted, where necessary, based on the actual deliv ery and inspection clearance of the detectors at BSP Stores. 29. All references to the number of detectors available for calibration shall mean the detectors actually ma de available by BSP during the relevant calibration visit. 30. The vendor shall be responsible for timely deployment of qualified service personnel and for providing all equipment, calibration gases, tools, documentation and logistical arrangements necessary to perform t he calibration activities. NOTE: DELIVERY SCHEDULE MENTIONED IN THE ATC OVERRULES DELIVERY SCHEDULE MENTIONED IN THE GEM BID. OTHER COMMERCIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS mentioned in attached ATC. . 3.
